Name: Coalescence Spell for Ores
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
[size=3]This brings you a bunch of new crafting recipes for metal bars, and allows for transforming 5 ores and a piece of coal to a bar without the need for a furnace.[/size]

I made this because I tinyfied everything and had no room for the furnace. Also because I always forget to bring the metal bars when I go to Clint. 😅


[u][size=3]The crafting recipes are received as follows:[/size][/u]

[list]
[*]Reaching Mining Level 1 gives you "turn copper ores to bars).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 3 gives you "turn iron ores to bars).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 5 gives you "turn gold ores to bars).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 7 gives you "turn iridium ores to bars).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 10 gives you "turn radioactive ores to bars).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 4 gives you "turn quartz to refined quartz).
[*]Reaching Mining Level 6 gives you "turn firequartz to refined quartz).
[/list]
Yes this is kind of an overpowered mod. Use it at your own risk of loss of gameplay challenge.
